imageFusion.description: Intelligently synthesize multiple portraits into one group photo, keeping facial features, hairstyle, and expression consistent.

furnitureShowcase.name: 3-Image Fusion · Furniture Showcase
furnitureShowcase.description: Intelligently blend people, pets, and furniture scenes, with highly consistent details, suitable for home, soft furnishing, and space display.

nailArt.description: Intelligently generate nail art patterns, beautify only the nails, keep other parts of the hand natural, suitable for nail design and display.

backgroundReplacement.name: Background Replacement for Portraits

addModelToClothing.name: Add Model to Clothing for E-commerce
addModelToClothing.description: Naturally blend models into clothing images, keeping clothing details unchanged, suitable for e-commerce clothing display and try-on effect generation.

partialEdit.name: Partial Edit
partialEdit.description: Only adjust the specified local area in the image (such as hair color, clothing, accessories, etc.), keeping other parts unchanged to meet personalized needs.

cartoonAvatar.name: Cartoon Avatar Generation

posterDesign.name: Poster Design

comicStrip.name: Comic Strip Generation
comicStrip.description: Turn photos into comic strips, support multi-panel layout and speech bubbles, suitable for storytelling.

sceneExpansion.name: Scene Expansion
sceneExpansion.description: Expand the background and scene of the image, keep the main subject unchanged, suitable for creative extension.

artQRCode.name: Artistic QR Code
artQRCode.description: Generate artistic QR codes with embedded images, support various styles and high recognition.

creativeCollage.name: Creative Collage
